configurePresets.name: Qt
configurePresets.description: Base preset for Qt toolchains; the inheriting (machine) preset must set the QTDIR environment variable

configurePresets.name: windows-desktop-msvc
configurePresets.description: Windows desktop base (MSVC, Visual Studio 2026); Qt kit path comes from QTDIR set by a machine preset

configurePresets.name: android-arm64-v8a
configurePresets.description: Android arm64-v8a base (Ninja). machine preset must set: QTDIR=<Qt android kit>, QT_HOST_PATH=<Qt desktop kit of the same version>, ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, ANDROID_NDK_ROOT. 必须使用 Qt 自带的 qt.toolchain.cmake：只有它才会注册 Qt 的 Android 打包链路（apk/aab 目标 + androiddeployqt），只用 NDK 的 android.toolchain.cmake 只能交叉编译、打不出 APK。
